quote: In 2017, Jerrard, Wetzel, and Yuan proved the final two Platonic solids (dodecahedron and icosahedron) have the property and formulated the conjecture that all convex polyhedra have the Rupert property
note: The concept of Rupert's property originates from Prince Rupert of the Rhine (1619–1682), with the first mathematical proof by John Wallis in 1693. However, the specific conjecture that every convex polyhedron has Rupert's property was formulated in 2017 by Jerrard, Wetzel, and Yuan.
